kab aayega

kal tak
haan ji
thoda der
order kaha hai
mera parcel
receipt chahiye

items.context: Aapka order abhi kaha tak pahucha hai
items.text: aur delivery kab hogi

items.context: Aap please apna address bata sakte hain
items.text: sirf address confirm karna hai

items.context: Kya aap order number share kar sakte hain?
items.text: haan ji confirm kar do
mera order Delhi me hi block ho gaya hai kya
aj ka delivery update chahiye mera address Gurgaon hai
mere naam par ek parcel aana tha Mumbai se
kya aapko pata hai ki mera package kis stage me hai
maine apne account se payment kar diya tha kal
kya aap please mere delivery agent se baat kar sakte hain
mare order me missent ka koi issue to nahi hua na
delivery boy ne mujhe kal call karne ko bola tha
kya aap confirm kar sakte hain ki mera order dispatch ho chuka hai
mera parcel kahaan tak pohucha hai aur estimated time kya hai
order ko time pe deliver karna hai mera address Bandra West mein hai

items.context: Kya aap apna delivery address confirm kar sakte hain
items.text: haan wo address wahi hai jo maine diya tha

items.context: Abhi tak aapne order ka koi update dekha hai kya
items.text: order tracking me last update last night 8 baje ka tha

items.context: Kya aap batayenge ke aapka package kis city se dispatch hua tha
items.text: mera parcel chennai se aana tha lekin delivery pending dikha raha hai

items.context: Aap apni location bata sakte hain jahaan parcel deliver hona tha
items.text: main Mumbai me hi hoon aur parcel late kyun hai kya reason hai

items.context: Aapko order ka batch number pata hai ya nahi
items.text: kya aap mujhe batch number aur order delivery ki date bata sakte ho

items.context: Kya aapko delivery executive ka contact chahiye
items.text: delivery boy ka contact number dena please mujhe problem ho rahi hai

items.context: Kya aap apna order jaldi receive karna chahte hain
items.text: order ko jaldi deliver karne ke liye kuch kar sakte hai kya

items.context: Kya aap check kar sakte hain ki aapka order abhi kaha hai
items.text: kya mera parcel abhi out for delivery hai

items.context: Aapka parcel kis city me derail hua hai
items.text: kya mera parcel manish nagar Nagpur tak pohoch gaya hai

items.context: Apko estimated delivery time chahiye ya exact delivery date
items.text: kya aap mujhe delivery ke liye expected time bata sakte hain

items.context: Kya aapko apna order cancel karna hai ya refund karna hai
items.text: order abhi tak dispatch kyu nahi hua mujhe refund chahiye

items.context: Order aapne kab book kiya tha aur expected delivery kab ki thi
items.text: mera order kal aana tha par abhi tak status update nahi hai
main Arjun hoon Chennai se aur mera ek parcel abhi tak deliver nahi hua hai main janna chahta hoon ki iska kya status hai
mera naam Pooja Singh hai aur mera order jo Lucknow mein deliver hona tha wo abhi tak pending hi hai kripya update de sakte hain
main Mumbai me rehti hoon aur mera ek piece order 3 din pehle book hua tha lekin tracking mein wo abhi tak dispatch hua show nahi kar raha hai

items.context: Kya aap mujhe bata sakte hain ki aapka delivery address kya hai
items.text: Aap se poochhna tha mera address correct hai par delivery mein itni der kyun ho rahi hai mujhe Kolkata se parcel aana tha par abhi tak receive nahi hua

items.context: Kya aap apni last order ki details share kar sakte hain
items.text: Mujhe kal se bar bar call aaraha hai ki mera parcel Chennai se dispatch ho gaya hai par main abhi tak receive nahi kar paya hoon iske baare mein jankari chahiye

items.context: Aap mujhe thodi aur information de sakte hain aapke order ke baare mein
items.text: Namaste mujhe mera parcel last week order kiya tha jo Delhi ke Pitampura area mein deliver hona tha wo abhi tak nahi mila hai kripya iska status update kariye

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: where_is_order - asks where their order or parcel is
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
